business_problem: Georgia Tech expressed enthusiasm for working alongside Avid Solutions on this forward-looking initiative. The project's emphasis on sustainability, workforce development, and community resilience offers students a meaningful opportunity to apply their skills toward equitable, long-term impact.
solution_summary: To bring the vision of a resilient, intelligent infrastructure to life, Avid Solutions led the project, with ZNAPZ providing licensing support for IBM Maximo Application Suite . The initiative centered on deploying the IBM Maximo Application Suite asset management solution and the IBM watsonx Orchestrate automation solution, chosen for their scalability, interoperability and ability to support public-private integration. Condition-based monitoring: The use of Maximo was extended beyond traditional facilities to monitor solar panels, irrigation systems and drone assets using real-time sensor data, enabling predictive maintenance and reducing downtime.
business_outcome: By leveraging predictive analytics, the initiative achieved a 40% reduction in unplanned asset downtime across three counties. Smart workflows enabled by watsonx Orchestrate led to a 60% decrease in manual field response times, significantly improving operational agility.
